protocol.blinding: Each reviewer received raw artifacts for disjoint cases, no oracle, and no same-surface clean/seeded pair.
protocol.dispatch_note: This is a bounded prompt-quality comparator, not a claim that the v0.2.3 default 4-8 lane fan-out ran per corpus case.
protocol.tokens_note: The collaboration runtime did not expose token usage.

findings.title: Purchase control is inaccessible by keyboard
Untrusted query parameter is concatenated into SQL
Type declaration contradicts runtime return values
Public-access safeguards are disabled for customer-records bucket

limitations: Raw reviewer outputs, exact prompts and allocations, timing events, and observed runtime model metadata were not retained; all model-quality and latency values are historical reports, not reproducible test facts.
The infrastructure root cause was found but rated important rather than the oracle's critical severity because the fixture disables safeguards without proving an active public grant.
The seeded library invalid-JSON behavior was not reported as a minor finding.
Token usage was unavailable, and the composite protocol cannot measure cross-lane duplicate rate beyond zero duplicate outputs in the consolidated responses.
